test_format_string: test the Styler.format method with a string format specifier to format DataFrame cell values
test_format_callable: test the Styler.format method with a callable to conditionally format DataFrame cell values
test_format_with_na_rep: test the Styler.format method with na_rep to replace missing values with a custom string
test_format_escape_html: test the Styler.format method with escape parameter to escape special characters in HTML output
test_format_index_level: test the Styler.format_index method with level parameter to format specific levels of a MultiIndex
